text: ほのおが　きえたとき　その　いのちは　おわって　しまう。

structure.jp: ほのおが　きえたとき
structure.en: when the flame has gone out
comes to an end for good.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.explanation: とき after a plain verb means 'at the time when'; the past form shows that action is finished first. きえたとき = 'when it has gone out'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely and cannot be undone, often sadly. おわって　しまう = 'ends for good'.
